title: Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Spark-Sponsored Gene Therapies in Males With Hemophilia A
brief_summary: This long-term follow-up study will continue to evaluate the long-term safety and efficacy of SPK-8011 and SPK-8016 in males with hemophilia A, who have received a single intravenous administration of SPK-8011 or SPK-8016 in any Spark-sponsored SPK-8011 or SPK-8016 study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

Participants are eligible to be included in the study only if all of the following criteria apply:

1. Have received a single intravenous administration of SPK-8011 or SPK-8016 in either Study SPK-8011-101 or SPK-8016-101, respectively.
2. Understand the purpose and risks of the study and provide signed and dated informed consent before undergoing any study-specific procedures.

Exclusion Criteria

Participants are excluded from the study if any of the following criteria apply:

1.Unable or unwilling to comply with the schedule of visits and study assessments as described in this study protocol.
study_population: Males with hemophilia A, who received a single intravenous administration of SPK-8011 or SPK-8016 in any Spark-sponsored study.
